verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an incident-management SaaS, but the pack documents no user-facing bulk edit or bulk action across many incidents, follow-ups, or alerts. Alert grouping, which lets you triage related alerts as one, is an adjacent automatic grouping feature rather than user-driven bulk operations. The general API and MCP server are only building blocks a developer could use to script bulk changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
